1.t: By the sun and its brightness

2.t: and the moon as it follows it

3.t: and the day as it unveils it

4.t: and the night as it conceals it

5.t: And by heaven and ˹the One˺ Who built it

6.t: and the earth and ˹the One˺ Who spread it

7.t: And by the soul and ˹the One˺ Who fashioned it

8.t: then with ˹the knowledge of˺ right and wrong inspired it

9.t: Successful indeed is the one who purifies their soul

10.t: and doomed is the one who corrupts it

11.t: Thamûd rejected ˹the truth˺ out of arrogance

12.t: when the most wicked of them was roused ˹to kill the she-camel˺

13.t: But the messenger of Allah warned them, “˹Do not disturb˺ Allah’s camel and her ˹turn to˺ drink!”
13.tr: Faqaala lahum Rasoolul laahi naaqatal laahi Wa-suqiyaahaa

14.t: Still they defied him and slaughtered her. So their Lord crushed them for their crime, levelling all to the ground
14.tr: Fakazzaboohu fa'aqaroohaa fadamdama 'alaihim Rabbuhum bizambihim fasaw-waahaa

15.t: He has no fear of consequences
